rationalists.name: rationalists
rationalists.ontology: Reality is lawful and knowable through Bayesian updating; beliefs should pay rent in anticipated experience, and most catastrophes are epistemic failures first.

doomers.name: AI-safety doomers
doomers.ontology: We are building minds we can't steer, on a timeline set by a race nobody can exit.

ea.name: effective altruists
ea.ontology: All sentient welfare counts equally across space and time; the real currency is counterfactual impact, measured and maximized under moral uncertainty.

Philanthropies are courting the new millionaires minted by US blockbuster IPOs and pitching them on giving pledges, the Business Times reported July 26.

tpot.name: tpot / post-rationalists
tpot.ontology: Rationality was a phase; wisdom might not be. Bodies, meaning, sincerity wearing irony as a coat.
tpot.tldr: rationality was a phase; wisdom might not be

Rolling Stone's July 15 feature 'Welcome to Vibecamp, an IRL Gathering for the Terminally Online' put the tpot festival in mainstream view, and the scene is still chewing on it.

nondual.name: consciousness & psychedelic twitter
nondual.ontology: The mystery is real, measurable, and schedulable. The clinical trial as pilgrimage route.
nondual.tldr: the mystery is real, measurable, schedulable

Psychology Today argued July 24 that industry and Washington are racing ahead on psychedelics faster than the evidence, a caution echoed across the clinical community.

btc.name: bitcoin maxis

girardians.name: girardians
girardians.tldr: desire is mimetic; scapegoats keep the peace

metamodern.name: metamodernists
metamodern.tldr: integrate irony and sincerity; develop in stages

cryonics.name: cryonicists
cryonics.tldr: death is information loss; preserve the pattern

pronatalists.name: pronatalists

cozyweb.tldr: small quiet internet over the big feed

tradcaths.name: trad catholics

indigenous.tldr: the land is a relative, not a resource
indigenous.ontology: The land is not a resource but a relative, and it is taking its names back. The oldest ontology on the map, newly load-bearing.

discussing.d: First Nations chiefs demanded an inquiry into Ontario's wildfire response on July 21, saying residents got little warning and some were forced to organize their own evacuations as 180-plus fires burned in the north.
A July 23 Narwhal investigation found Doug Ford's government had been handed dozens of First Nations recommendations to improve northern emergency response before the fires -- and ignored them.
In Nain, Nunatsiavut, thawing permafrost is shifting the ground beneath an Inuit community's homes, The Narwhal reported July 28.

manifestation.name: the manifestation web
manifestation.tldr: align the inner state; the outer follows
manifestation.ontology: Reality is a mirror: align the inner state and the outer world follows. The largest folk religion online, and it doesn't know it's one.

discussing.d: USA Today's July 28 premiere coverage has Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Tom Holland talking up the 'powers of manifesting,' pushing manifestation talk back through celebrity media.
Allure's July 13 report profiles women who believe they can manifest a slimmer jaw, the latest beauty-adjacent frontier of manifesting TikTok.

A July 23 essay by Walker Larson calls the law-of-attraction classic The Secret 'poison,' part of a wave of Christian pushback that also includes Focus on the Family's July warning about manifesting on social media.

conspiracy.name: the conspiracist omniverse
conspiracy.tldr: nothing is as it seems, on purpose
conspiracy.ontology: Nothing is as it seems, and someone meant it that way. Every institution's collapse in trust washes up here as new territory.

discussing.d: Trump AG nominee Todd Blanche begged a judge not to fine him $1,000 a day over withheld Epstein files (July 21) while Epstein survivors lobbied senators to block his confirmation.
Daniel Siad, a French modeling scout named thousands of times in the Epstein files, was found dead in his Paris home on July 22, instantly fueling witness-cleanup theories across cover-up forums.
An external review reported by AP on July 21 found the Gates Foundation met with Epstein about 30 times despite staff concerns, fresh grist for elite cover-up discourse.

hustle.name: hustle world
hustle.tldr: the job is a scam; the way out is volume
hustle.ontology: The job is a scam and the way out is volume: content, flips, funnels, reps. YouTube's biggest religion.

discussing.d: Meta launched a new app that makes it easier to run a Facebook Marketplace resale side hustle, per Inc.'s July 24 report, and flipper communities are sizing it up.
A widely shared July 25 AOL/GOBankingRates piece says 72% of Gen Z now has a side hustle, framing multiple income streams as the generational default.
Entrepreneur's July 21 profile of a side hustle that made over $100K at farmers' markets and is 'on track for $1M' ('give yourself 30 days') is the week's template success story.

manosphere.name: the manosphere
manosphere.tldr: rebuild the man; the world follows
manosphere.ontology: The crisis is male — purpose, testosterone, marriage, meaning. Rebuild the man and the world follows.

discussing.d: Andrew and Tristan Tate will sit in a Miami jail at least two more weeks while fighting extradition to the UK on rape and trafficking charges, per NBC's July 27 hearing coverage; Andrew claims guards serve 'poisoned water.'
A congresswoman asked House Republicans on July 24 to investigate Andrew Tate's reported ties to Barron Trump, and by July 27 members of Congress wanted Barron to answer questions.
The Bulwark (July 23) documented parts of MAGA rallying around Tate while The New Republic (July 28) reported Trumpworld quietly cutting him loose — the manosphere is arguing over which side to take.

witchtok.name: witchtok & the old ways
witchtok.tldr: ritual, tarot, the moon as calendar
witchtok.ontology: The disenchanted world re-enchants from below: ritual, tarot, the moon as calendar. The gods that were here before the feed.

discussing.d: Reuters reported July 23 that South Koreans are paying tarot readers to divine what their dogs and cats are feeling, a 'pet tarot' wellness trend WitchTok is amplifying.
Malay Mail's July 26 report says tarot spreads and paid career spells are luring desperate US and European job hunters in stagnant labor markets.
A July 25 Guardian essay argues what really makes a woman a 'witch' is financial independence, feeding the week's discourse on why witch identity keeps surging.

socialist.name: the socialist left
socialist.tldr: the oldest war is labor versus capital
socialist.ontology: The oldest war is labor versus capital; everything else is noise over that signal.

discussing.d: The New York Times reported July 26 that democratic socialists are 'winning big' electorally and the movement is now demanding its elected officials deliver, as DSA's platform and funding draw national fire.
Mayor Mamdani said July 27 that NYC's city-owned grocery stores will sell essential items at 30% discounts while vowing not to compete with local shops.
NYC landlords sued the city on July 22 over the Mamdani-backed rent freeze, per the Wall Street Journal, setting up the left's marquee housing fight.

postliberal.name: the post-liberals
postliberal.tldr: rebuild on faith, family, common good
postliberal.ontology: Liberalism ate its own foundations; rebuild on faith, family, and the common good.

discussing.d: The Dispatch's July 1 piece 'For Postliberals, Birthright Citizenship Is the New Roe' framed the movement's next constitutional crusade, still being argued over in postliberal circles this month.
Political theorist Matt Sleat's July 11 interview at illiberalism.org dissects post-liberalism, the common good, and liberal perfectionism — a current reference point in the Vermeule/Deneen debate.
A July 3 Washington Examiner essay argued that at America's 250th anniversary 'postliberalism risks undoing America,' the sharpest recent liberal-conservative counterattack on the movement.

refusal.name: tech refusal
refusal.tldr: the only winning move is to log off
refusal.ontology: The machine's product is your attention, and the only winning move is to log off. The decelerate coast's far shore.

discussing.d: Districts from Oakland (all-day ban announced July 23) to Denver, Wichita, Maine and all of Indiana are rolling out bell-to-bell phone bans as the 2026-27 school year opens.
Sens. Amy Klobuchar and Marsha Blackburn are both pushing school cell phone bans at the federal level, per July 21-24 local coverage of their proposals.
Savannah Arts Academy students petitioned against Georgia's phone ban on July 27 citing safety concerns, while a July 21 BGR roundup notes studies show bans may not raise grades.

dacc.name: d/acc
dacc.ontology: Accelerate the defensive things — crypto, bio-defense, open source — so the power lands in everyone's hands.

discussing.d: An Nvidia-led corporate letter defending open-weight AI models doubled to 50 signers by July 26 — notably without Amazon or Anthropic — as Washington weighs restricting Chinese models like Kimi K3.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said July 27-28 he is not advocating a ban on open-weight models but fears Chinese AI and wants mandatory safety testing, per TechCrunch and CNBC.
Vitalik Buterin backed FOCIL censorship-resistance inclusion lists as Ethereum scheduled its Hegota upgrade (July 25), pitching a 4-year plan to make Ethereum 'the chain you can rely on.'

liminal.name: the liminal web
liminal.tldr: hold the whole; don't pick a jersey
liminal.ontology: The crisis under the crises is sensemaking itself; hold the whole, don't pick a jersey.

discussing.d: Adam Tooze's July 26 Chartbook 461 links the polycrisis frame to 'nostalgia for lost futures,' the week's most-shared big-picture sensemaking essay.
A July 6 'definitional field guide' from Adapt Research Writing sorts out polycrisis vs. metacrisis vs. systemic risk, circulating in sensemaking circles as the terms leak into mainstream use.

Jonathan Rowson's Joyous Struggle newsletter is in an intimate summer mode — his July 7 post reflects on a diabetic episode and small joys, after June essays on embodied cognition and political absurdity.

nihilists.name: the nihilist trench
nihilists.ontology: Nothing means anything and nothing is worth wanting — the undertow beneath every other territory. Named here as a hazard to navigation, not steelmanned, by design.
